# Ansible Tower/AWX Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > DevOps > Ansible

## Overview

Configures Ansible Tower or AWX for enterprise automation with job templates, workflows, and RBAC for team collaboration

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [ansible-tower-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
ansible-tower-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@ansible-tower-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure job templates with proper credentials
- Build workflow templates for complex automation
- Implement RBAC with organizations and teams
- Set up surveys for parameterized execution

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Ansible Tower**: Enterprise automation platform configuration
- **Workflows**: Multi-step automation orchestration
- **RBAC**: Role-based access control for automation
